labels.unresolved: TRUE OPEN BETFLAG NON CERTIFICATA — MOVIMENTO INCOMPLETO

rules: Never present a GoldBet opening price as a BetFlag opening price.
GoldBet may only fill the historical-opening reference when the exact fixture, market, period, line and selection identity match.
BET/NO BET price gate always uses a fresh verified BetFlag price, never the GoldBet proxy.
Keep BetFlag direct movement snapshots separate from the GoldBet opening proxy.
When both GoldBet proxy open and BetFlag first/open observation exist, store their absolute and percentage difference for validation.
Do not promote the proxy to TRUE OPEN BETFLAG unless independently source-certified as BetFlag.

validation.future_confidence_model: calibrate only from matched historical samples; no assumed equivalence
